Chapter 1212 - 25 Invincible Great Saint? (Request Subscription)_2

Chapter 1212: Chapter 25 Invincible Great Saint? (Request Subscription)_2

What kind of chaotic evolutionary path exhibits such power just in its nascent stage?

...

Outside, deep within the Chaos Continent of the Galaxy.

Lin Yuan was deeply immersed in his comprehensive transformation, feeling the impact of the Chaotic Taiji Dao on him, like a giant pillar supporting everything.

"Hmm?"

The Tai Chi Diagram mark on Lin Yuan’s brow slowly rotated, with an inexplicable ripple centered on him—

spreading in all directions,

toward Heaven and Earth,

toward the Chaos Void.

"Is this imprinting my Dao into this Chaos Void?"

Lin Yuan considered thoughtfully. The birth of any Chaos Great Saint would undergo this process, imprinting their Dao onto chaos.

"It’s also a kind of anchor point, a Dao beacon." Lin Yuan did not interfere. Imprinting one’s Dao into chaos connected with the Chaos Void, and such a connection could have some effects even if one fell into a time loop.

Whether imprinting one’s Dao into chaos or spreading the paths of one’s evolution, the goal is to establish anchor points, Dao beacons.

But to break through the time loop, it mainly falls on oneself; these methods at most provide auxiliary effects.

However, for Lin Yuan, he would certainly not pass up any means to aid in breaking through the time loop, striving to elevate external conditions to the highest before addressing anything else.

...

The Chaotic Taiji Dao swiftly merged into the boundless void.

At that moment.

Special entities in various hidden places within the Chaos Void seemed to sense something, gazing distantly towards the direction of the Chaos Continent of the Galaxy.

"Is a Chaos Great Saint being born, imprinting their Dao into chaos?"

"A new path of chaotic evolutionary power is being born. But is this really a newly born path of chaotic power? How is it much more terrifying than some peerless Great Saints?"

The special entities were somewhat incredulous.

As special entities, they are mostly related to the Thirteenth Realm, like the Eye of Myriad Laws, or spirits of various mysterious places, etc.

Their ancientness bore witness to the rise and fall of many Chaos Great Saints, peerless Great Saints, and even Invincible Great Saints. Usually, the imprinting of one’s Dao by a Chaos Great Saint would not draw their attention.

But now, as the Chaotic Taiji Dao continued to diffuse and imprint, the whole Chaos Void was undergoing some subtle and significant changes, which shocked many special entities.

"It’s the Galaxy Great Saint, who not long ago suppressed several other Chaos Great Saints in the Xuanhuang Universe. At that time, the power of the Galaxy Great Saint was only near that of a peerless Great Saint."

Immediately, a special entity recognized Lin Yuan, the severed long blade: "This Galaxy Great Saint must have cultivated the Thirteenth Realm legacy representing foundational heritage, which allowed sweeping over other Chaos Great Saints without having evolved a path of chaotic power."

"That legacy? Truly remarkable. But reaching near peerless Great Saint without evolving a path of chaotic power, and now evolving such a formidable path of chaotic power, isn’t that directly a peerless Great Saint?"

The special entities communicated amongst themselves. With their long-lived experiences, they showed little interest in ordinary Great Saints. However, an Invincible Great Saint? Only one emerges after a long Cosmic Era. Every Invincible Great Saint leaves a unique imprint in the Chaos Void, naturally earning a high regard from these special entities.

Especially an unconventional Invincible Great Saint like Lin Yuan? Just evolved a path of chaotic power, already deemed an Invincible Great Saint? This kind of elevation and transformation might not have happened since the inception of the Chaos Void.

"This Galaxy Great Saint, as long as nothing unexpected happens, growing smoothly, can rank among the top five, or even top three, of all Invincible Great Saints in the history of our Chaos Void."

A special entity expressed with astonishment.

The condition for the birth of an Invincible Great Saint is to sweep across all Great Saints of the era, earning the respect and submission of numerous Great Saints, thus two Invincible Great Saints theoretically would not face each other to determine victory.

However, in the hearts of many special entities, they still ranked the previously born Invincible Great Saints, but without exception, Lin Yuan’s current performance, even among Invincible Great Saints, was extraordinarily dazzling, even unfathomable.

"Galaxy Great Saint?"

Amidst numerous special entities, the Eye of Myriad Laws was filled with emotion, long convinced that Lin Yuan at the very least would become an Invincible Great Saint, but this day came so soon?

And growing smoothly in the future, ranking among the top five or even top three of all Invincible Great Saints in the history of the Chaos Void?

Don’t underestimate this top five or top three; the Chaos Void has nurtured countless freakish and monstrous beings over endless ages, and ranking among the top five or top three is quite extraordinary.

This includes some special periods when Thirteenth Realm time entities took personal interest and cultivated disciples themselves, etc.

...

Deep within the Chaos Continent of the Galaxy.

After evolving a path of chaotic power, Lin Yuan’s perception significantly enhanced, noticing subtle feelings of being watched the moment he imprinted his Dao into chaos.

"Is it those special entities?"

Lin Yuan did not pay much attention, regarding the Moyu Tower Master or Xuanhuang as merely being wary of those special entities. Fear? Absolutely none.

For these special entities cannot actively take action; as long as you don’t provoke them, there will be no issues, and even if provoked, their backing Thirteenth Realm time entities may not necessarily pay attention.

"My current strength..."

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts. After the intense initial transformation, his pace of improvement gradually slowed, though even this slower pace was one that ordinary Chaos Great Saints could not potentially rival.

The extent of enhancement from a Chaos Great Saint evolving a path of chaotic power depends on the path itself. Most Chaos Great Saints’ paths differ slightly, making their enhancements similar.

But Lin Yuan?

The prerequisite requirement for the evolution of the Chaotic Taiji Dao Light—comprehension of the Second Realm—was already beyond reach for nearly all Chaos Great Saints.

This Second Realm peak here solely refers to Lin Yuan, but for other beings: without Against-Heaven’s Understanding, one must reach the Third Realm.

...

Inner universe.

Beside the jade gourd, a girl in red stood, feeling the changes in each instant of the Spacetime Great Dao, momentarily at a loss for words.

Hum.

Lin Yuan’s figure coalesced beside her, smiling as he looked at the girl in red.

"What kind of chaotic power path did you evolve?" The girl in red couldn’t resist asking.

"What kind of chaotic power path?" Lin Yuan pondered briefly, then said: "I call it Chaos Taiji."

The moment he finished speaking.

The girl in red saw Lin Yuan raise his right hand, with black and white interwoven breaths swirling, although only at the fingertips, yet its influence radiated through layers of spacetime.

"Chaos Taiji? This should be the strongest path of chaotic power I have seen."

The girl in red added hastily after speaking, as if struck by a thought: "Except for the old master."

In her words, the old master naturally referred to the creator of the "Infinite Void," that Thirteenth Realm time entity.

"Certainly, I cannot compare with the great time entities."

Lin Yuan smiled and shook his head. The more he cultivated, the more he felt the gap with the Thirteenth Realm.

Lin Yuan, comprehending the Thirteenth Realm weapon Sky Void Tripod, experiencing the retained imprints within, knew a trace of power from a Thirteenth Realm time entity could utterly destroy myriad void domains.

"Is there any Eternal Gold left?"

Lin Yuan looked at the girl in red, and asked.

Eternal Gold is a special metal material used specifically to measure the strength of one’s inner universe.

Previously, when Lin Yuan cultivated to around the second layer of "Infinite Void," he measured the level of his inner universe with this metal.

"There are still some." The girl in red nodded: "Why do you need Eternal Gold?"

With a faint smile, Lin Yuan calmly replied: "I want to know how strong I am now."
